text:
sam: Quick thread to nail Helios pilot pricing and packaging. They want predictable spend but also a way to ramp. Can we propose a phased-commit pilot + ops add-ons?
anya: We can do phased commits. Typical structure: month1 25% commit, month2 50%, month3 100% with final commit conversion or walkaway. Need floor numbers.
mike: Infra note: phased commit helps capacity planning. If they want guaranteed p95 we must reserve a GPU pool for the conversion month. That means a one-time placement fee or higher commit.
zoe: Sales prefers one SKU for pilot paperwork. Helios asked for audit log retention and higher retention of embeddings as a paid addon. Also asked about on-prem option later.
sam: Draft proposal sketch:
```
Phased Pilot (6 weeks / 3 months option):
- Phase A (30 days): 25% commit, $5k floor, soft burst credits up to 2x
- Phase B (30 days): 50% commit, $12k floor, reserved burst window
- Conversion month: 100% commit, $25k min to move to Performance package
Add-ons (metered):
- Dedicated GPU pool (reserved pods): +$8k/mo
- Audit & retention (90 days -> 365 days): +$1k/mo per TB
- Private deploy option (VPC): one-time setup $10k + recurring network fee
SLA: 99.9% for Performance after conversion. No formal SLA during Phase A/B but we document expected SLOs.
Pilot credits: $4k usage credit applied across phases.
```
anya: Floors look ok but $5k floor for Phase A might scare smaller teams; finance can stretch if we get a signed conversion commitment. We need a fail-safe: a minimum effective ARR to accept the phased schedule.
pricing-bot: cost-delta estimate: reserved GPU pool adds ~30% infra cost on affected nodes. Audit retention add-on is low marginal cost but storage ops + egress ~12% recurring. Pilot credits reduce first-year margin by ~6%.
mike: Operationally, I suggest adding a rollback clause: if error budget >5% in a week, we throttle non-critical traffic and trigger on-call. Also an automated downgrade path if burst concurrency >x for >10m. I'll draft the runbook.
legal-bot: note: include clear termination notice and data-handling clause for pilot. For phased commit, add explicit conversion deadline and opt-out window. Do not promise SLA before conversion.
sam: Sales action: I'll present this to Helios tomorrow. Two asks for product/legal: (1) short plain-language pilot terms for customer-facing doc, (2) a one-paragraph list of what counts as "burst" vs "steady" for billing.
zoe: I'll make a customer-facing one-pager. @mike please give the `burst` definition (qps window, p95 threshold) and I'll translate into customer wording.
mike: Burst definition: short windows under 10 minutes where sustained qps > 3x baseline and p95 latency < 300ms if served from cache; otherwise treated as reserved-burst and billed at add-on rate.
anya: Confirming finance: we can accept the phased floors if we get an explicit conversion trigger (signed PO or auto-convert after month3). Otherwise require a stronger floor in Phase A.
sam: OK final checklist: @anya confirm final floor numbers, @mike runbook + burst definition, @legal-bot short pilot T&Cs. If all green I'll send the one-pager to Helios.
zoe: Thanks team, will assemble and share draft by EOD. :rocket:
